nodes.label: securityContext: non-root, readOnlyRootFS, drop ALL caps
Probe Handlers: httpGet, tcpSocket, exec, grpc
PVC Access Modes: RWO, ROX, RWX, RWOP
StatefulSet (ordered identity, stable DNS, per-pod storage)
Headless Service (clusterIP: None, stable DNS per pod)
RoleBinding (binds subject to role in a namespace)
Cloud Workload Identity: IRSA (EKS), Workload Identity (GKE/AKS)
Pod Security Admission (replaces PSP in K8s 1.25+)
Graceful Shutdown (SIGTERM, exec-form CMD, preStop race)
Secrets as Volume Mounts (not env vars)
CNI requirement for NetworkPolicy enforcement (Calico, Cilium)
Probe Tuning Fields: initialDelaySeconds, periodSeconds, failureThreshold
Slow-Startup Trap: liveness without startupProbe causes CrashLoopBackOff
DaemonSet tolerations (run on ALL tainted nodes)
kubectl drain (respects PDB during node eviction)
